name: Lindy
tagline: Build AI employees that handle your busywork
description: Lindy is a no-code platform for building autonomous AI agents ("Lindies") that handle email triage, calendar scheduling, CRM updates, customer support, and recruiting workflows. Users describe a goal in natural language and connect tools — Lindy plans, executes, and learns from feedback. It supports 3,000+ integrations, multi-agent orchestration, and trigger-based automation.
pricingDetails: Free: 400 credits/month. Pro: $49.99/month. Business: $199.99/month. Enterprise: custom.
